import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    list1 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + n]))
    idx += n
    
    m = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    list2 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + m]))
    idx += m
    
    # Merge the two lists
    merged = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    
    while i < n and j < m:
        if list1[i] <= list2[j]:
            merged.append(list1[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(list2[j])
            j += 1
    
    # Add remaining elements
    merged.extend(list1[i:])
    merged.extend(list2[j:])
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, merged)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
